text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, during training with Cheval 
Grand...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? My body feels cramped, or like 
it's being squeezed...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I... I m-might have... g-gained... weight!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The cafeteria food looked so 
good... I couldn't help getting... extra 
side dishes...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...... I... need to go on a diet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand looks downcast, but it's also 
my responsibility for failing to manage 
her weight properly...
choice_data_list: In that case, I have a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you really sure about this? Isn't 
dieting supposed to be tough...?"
choice_data_list:
Let's burn those calories while having fun 
our own way!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...True, I feel like my mind and body are 
clearing up. Maybe I should just play to 
my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
In the great ocean... I'll burn away the 
fat!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Cheval Grand played around on the 
beach and burned off plenty of fat.
